newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine bolsa ends slightly lower, trims losses.
newsitem.headline: Argentine bolsa ends slightly lower, trims losses.

text.p: Argentine stocks trimmed losses Monday to close slightly lower after prices, which have declined for five days in a row, dropped to attractive levels triggering a late wave of purchasing, dealers said.
The market cut losses on the back of a strong liquidity that also helped Wall Street to buck its declining trend.

But volume fell strongly to $24 million from $34 million Friday. The market's attention is focused on U.S. Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan's speech before the Senate on Wednesday and U.S. unemployment data to be released Friday.
The local stock market close 0.16 percent lower at 716.46 points.
